The '''Dentaalian House''' was the governmental authority of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]]. It was disbanded when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Taliff]] was appointed to rule the planet. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the members of the House met and passed a resolution declaring its intention to not recognize the [[Imperial Charter/Legends|Imperial Charter]] or Governor Taliff's authority.
